cards.title: Handling Endogenous Analytes
cards.claim: For analytes that are also endogenous molecules, standard validation is complicated by background levels. Approaches include Surrogate Matrix, Surrogate Analyte, Background Subtraction, and Standard Addition. For QCs spiked with authentic analyte in matrix containing endogenous analyte, Accuracy (%) = 100 × (measured concentration of the spiked sample - endogenous concentration) / nominal added concentration. For unspiked endogenous QCs, only precision can be determined.
conditions: Endogenous concentration in matrix should be low (<20% of LLOQ) for standard approaches.
Surrogate approaches require parallelism and matrix effect evaluation against authentic matrix.
required_inputs: Endogenous concentration levels in blank matrix.
Surrogate standards or stripped matrix if applicable.
limitations: Surrogate matrix/analyte approaches may have different matrix effects/recoveries than authentic matrix.
Standard addition is only for linear response platforms.
cards.downstream_use: Critical for PK/PD of endogenous compounds or replacement therapies. Prevents overestimation of exposure due to background noise.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
